note: Hand-picked art direction. The Samobi library mixes clean in-room renders with raw showroom phone shots under fluorescent light. Only images listed in `editorial` are ever shown large (hero, full-bleed, collection covers). Everything else is confined to small gallery thumbs on the product page.

images._note: Own photography, replacing the scraped set for a piece. Filenames live in media-src/ and survive a re-ingest, since ingest only writes the scraped list and media.mjs applies these over the top.

products._note: Pieces that exist as Valo photography but not in Samobi's WooCommerce catalogue, and corrections to pieces that do exist — a name here overrides the one the API returns. media.mjs applies both. `category` is the kind of piece; the range it belongs to is set in `collections` below. Price is null until Samobi supplies one; the app then omits it.

exclude._note: Pieces removed from the catalogue. Kept as a list rather than deleted from the source so a re-ingest cannot quietly bring them back.

schematics._note: Dimensioned plan drawings. Processed by scripts/schematics.mjs into ink-on-transparent artwork so they sit on the page as a printed plan rather than as a pasted screenshot.

variants._note: The same piece photographed in another colour. Names are the ones read off the photographs, not derived from an average pixel — averaging called terracotta burgundy and olive mustard. Add a slug here and rerun scripts/swatches.mjs to give that piece a colour picker. An entry may also state its own `swatch` hex, for the head-on bed shots where the mattress fills the band the sampler reads.

views._note: Extra frames of a piece beyond the colour shots — the angle, the side, the sofa opened out, the storage box lifted. `in` is the colour the frame was shot in: the gallery shows the views belonging to the selected colour, so a product page is one colour throughout and changes as a whole when the picker moves.

headers._note: Full-bleed image at the top of a collection page. Falls back to `covers` when a collection has no entry here — split out because a studio cut-out can work as a small cover and still be wrong behind a headline.

collections._note: Named ranges — one design carried across several kinds of piece. Membership is listed rather than matched on the name: a rename then never moves a piece silently, and a near-miss like Coltar Bela never joins Bella. `cover` is optional and falls back to the first piece listed.

sizes._note: Mattress widths in cm, offered across a whole category. Keyed by category so every bed picks them up without being listed one by one; a slug key under `pieces` overrides the category for a single piece.
